goal: Rate limit the login endpoint to 5 attempts per minute per IP.
whatWasDone: Added a small in-memory sliding-window rate limiter middleware and applied it to the login route with a limit of 5 attempts per minute per IP. Tests passed and the change was committed.

decisions.decision: Write an in-memory sliding-window limiter instead of adding a package
decisions.reason: There is no existing dependency and only a single API instance.

risksOrFollowUps: The in-memory limiter will not hold across multiple API instances.
